title: Country not shown for some regions

comments_data.body:
Could you explain how the fix works please @lebaphi ?

It's not _good engineering_ for `json-editor` to know about the structure of both the schema _and_ the message.

I wonder if there are alternative solutions?
Closing this issue. We no longer rely on dependent arrays.

issues.title: Country not shown for some regions
issues.body:
Note: this issue can be reproduced by entering the `Papa Foxtrot` game as `Blue Senior`, going into the `Blue COAs` channel, and creating a new COA document.

We're using JSON-Schema `dependencies` to make one drop-down control dependent upon the value of another.

But, this is breaking when we edit an existing document:
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/01efa0c1d029b276bf6cfd47027441b8.gif)

It works fine for new documents:
![screencast 2](https://i.gyazo.com/99b8c0adbff6544fd9ed08aea1a52eae.gif)

Aah, note how the control moves to the right for some values.  That _may_ be down to the length of the USA country name. Will experiment.

Note: resizing the browser window makes the missing control appear:
![screencast 3](https://i.gyazo.com/6701e02da08de7703dcdc13829a18507.gif)

comments.body:
Yes, it works when creating a new document. But, it doesn't work when editing one.

So, you will `Submit` the one you're looking at.  It will collapse. Then you will `Claim` it, and it will collapse again.  Then, you can edit the existing document - and you should see the second drop-down disappears until the window is resized.
